# #1568 summary workload adaptation

The original stored answers are preserved in issue-1568-legacy.json. The modern
fixture preserves all nine budget names, targets, bases and task URLs and the four
changed repositories. Manager ruling c-86c86f3637c99e5f05c5f82c3cc1fafa permits
replacing gate time and change cycle time with image retention and upload bandwidth,
with full reasons, because modern feature checklists exclude root concerns. Six
explicitly in-scope omissions still exercise the unchanged 3000-character ceiling.

The first seven telemetry cells and eighth direct cell are illustrative workload
estimates, not historical command facts or measured runtimes. The illustrative direct
row uses a loopback journey command description; its historical telemetry command is
retained in the exact legacy fixture. The ninth stays legacy
and has neither source nor runtime. Realistic-data detail stays in project answers.
The production summary command runtime estimate is 1 second: the spike's complete
prototype took 0.148521053 seconds, plus estimated resolution/startup overhead;
this is an estimate, not measured production timing.
